findings: Completed remaining chunk/encode/migration docs. Unknown-chunk getter contract explicitly copies a list sized by queried count; this confirms v31 observed single-structure copy violates documented behavior.

Arbitrary-length metadata borrows context/user storage; copying list structures does not extend pointed-data lifetime. Encoder output transfers ownership only on successful get_png_buffer after finalization.

Migration maps RGB-to-gray transforms to unsupported; output layouts explicit, no source-dependent automatic alpha/channel transforms. This explains why libphash cannot request generic grayscale by choosing G8 alone.
Gamma mapping assumes screen gamma2.2; it is not equivalent to independent linear-RGB normalization. Migration table typo SPNG_DECODE_GAMA differs from actual SPNG_DECODE_GAMMA enum.
Encoder documentation performance percentages are upstream claims; no speed/compression evidence adopted. Existing suite has compression-size assertion disabled as recorded earlier.
Docs/chunk.md notes ICC payloads are not validated by spng; own color-management path and sourceprofile handling must be qualified separately.
No new compilation/test/benchmark during shared resource window; work limited to pinned text retrieval and review.
